notes.title: Mystic Vale - 4.0.2 Released!
notes.content:
Hi Mystic Vale fans!

We've just rolled out a new patch for Mystic Vale that fixes some issues reported by our community. If you notice any other issues with the game, feel free to let us know here on the Steam forums.

Fixed:

* Starting an online game would sometimes not show the expansions owned in the lobby.
* Combinations of advancements on one card that should bring up the same dialog multiple times are now fixed in all cases.

If you'd like to discuss Mystic Vale, find people to play with or chat to our lovely dev team you can join our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/nomadgames]Discord here[/url].

notes.title: Mystic Vale Version 4.0.0 Released!
notes.content:
Hey Mystic Vale fans!

Today we rolled out the 4.0.0 update for Mystic Vale, which fixes a number of known issues. You can find a full list of fixes below:

[h1]Fixed[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Wild Spirit Cost dialog, that appears when buying a Vale card that costs >1 Wild Spirit, no longer lets the player select bad amounts of Spirit symbols

[*] Mist Sylphs has been corrected

[*] Nightvale Pathfinder no longer shows advancements that the player can't fit on any of their cards

[*] When you have a Burrow Wyrm and a Hatchery on the same card, choosing to discard in Burrow Wyrm's dialog will no longer discard the card if Hatchery's ability is in effect

[*] Fixed Frostcrown Crest and Silver Tree not giving their bonuses when Twilight Shard is evoked but remains on its active side

[*] Fixed Summoner Stone not triggering some Harvest abilities on summoned cards

[*] Fixed an issue with the store UI buttons not updating the highlights correctly after cancelling/making a purchase

[*] Fixed an issue with the news UI not updating correctly after cancelling/making a purchase

[/list]

[h1]A Update on Nintendo Switch[/h1]

In other exciting news, this version of Mystic Vale is the same version that we will be bringing out on Nintendo Switch on March 12th! So that means you'll be able to cross-platform play with all your Nintendo Switch owning friends and foes from day one.

Want to play Mystic Vale on the Nintendo Switch? [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/mystic-vale-switch/]Check it out on the official Nintendo website.[/url]

notes.title: Mystic Vale version 3.1.0 release!
notes.content:
[h1][b]What's new in version 3.1.0[/b][/h1]
[h1]Added[/h1]
[list]
[*] Option to automatically switch to the active player tab when the turn advances, even if they aren't a human
[*] Option to locally disable the online chat filter
[/list]

[h1]Changed[/h1]
[list]
[*] Growth counter now displays the total Growth from the player's Field and On-Deck card, rather than the surplus Growth, in response to player feedback
[*] Seed Sowers' dialog now selects the maximum amount of Mana by default
[*] Deck Browser pages can no longer be interacted with until they finish loading
[*] Names of other local human players are now editable, except for the least recently added human who is assumed to be the account holder
[*] Applied a character limit of 20 to editable user names and online game names
[/list]

[h1]Fixed[/h1]
[list]
[*] AI: Fixed issue where the AI would never choose to activate Seed Sowers
[*] GAMEPLAY: Fixed Frostcrown Crest not adding +2 Mana when Twilight Shard is evoked but remains on its active side
[*] GAMEPLAY: Seed Sowers is no longer usable when Spoiled
[*] GAMEPLAY: Fixed hang when the player Spoils with no On-Deck card
[*] GAMEPLAY: Fixed issue with the amount of Final VP awarded by Medusa Grotto
[*] ONLINE: Fixed issue where users could not join any room listed after the first closed room
[*] ONLINE: Fixed issue where changing game options rapidly would cause some of them to reset
[*] UI/ONLINE: Fixed the location of the Turn Timer when playing the game at a wider than 16:9 aspect ratio
[*] UI: Fixed the Amulet view within My Collection not responding correctly to the Esc key
[*] UI: An Advancement transitioning back to the Commons can no longer be zoomed in, causing the card to be displayed both in the commons and the zoomed in view
[*] UI: Fixed the Deck Info dialog on the Results Screen briefly displaying the player's name in the colour of the previously selected player
[*] UI: Interrupting the Flip Leaders/Amulets animation in the My Collection area would lock up the Leader/Amulet shelf
[*] UI: Fixed animations disappearing on certain operating system configurations
[*] Screenshots taken through Steam now have the correct App ID
[/list]

notes.title: TIGA Awards and Druids Collection!
notes.content:
[h1]TIGA Awards[/h1]
Exciting news for Mystic Vale! We've been shortlisted for TIGA's [b]Game of the Year Awards.[/b] We're up against some massive studios, so just being nominated is super exciting for everyone here at Nomad Games.

The TIGA Awards are one of the industry’s most exciting and prestigious events, and their Game of the Year awards are open to voting from the public! We'd massively appreciate any votes from our players. 

Voting closes at Midnight on October 18th, but there is still time to vote! You can do so here on the [b][url=https://t.co/jGSW7coGMs?amp=1]TIGA website[/url][/b].

[h1]Druids Collection [/h1]
Also, we've just added a new 'complete your collection' bundle to the Steam store for Mystic Vale, for anyone who bought any individual expansions for Mystic Vale and is looking to complete their collection at a discount.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/12386/Druids_Collection/]Check it out here![/url]

It's still cheaper to buy the season pass if you want all the expansions, but we wanted to give anyone who bought individual expansions the ability to complete their collection!

As always, feel free to reach out to us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/NomadGamesLTD/]Facebook[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/Nomadgames]Twitter[/url], or join our lovely [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/nomadgames]Discord community[/url]!

notes.title: The Mana Storm Expansion has arrived!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34002419/9ccef417ff0ee3ec4b248d948529b630f2ed6b30.png[/img]

[h1]Mana Storm is OUT NOW[/h1]
We’re excited to release Mystic Vale: Mana Storm 🌱🐺

The battle to save the cursed land hasn’t ended. More druids have joined the forces alongside other creatures who are eager to see the day we’re all free from the accused blight. Mana Storm brings new mechanics and ways to strategise through Negative Victory Points and Amulets.

[h1]Season Pass holders[/h1]
Firstly we'd like to say a huge thank you to all our Season Pass holders for your support, we hope you enjoy the final piece of the Season Pass 💚 You’ll be able to find Mana Storm sitting in-game ready for you after the quick update!

[h1]Pick Up Mana Storm today![/h1]
If you want to pick up the Season Pass and gain access to all the expansions instantly you can find it here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1032290/Mystic_Vale__Season_Pass/

Or you can pick Mana storm up separately here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1097510/Mana_Storm/


[h1]Looking for some online competition?[/h1]
If you haven't already, why not join our Discord channel? We have a dedicated room for Mystic Vale where you can find other Druids to play against [url=https://discordapp.com/channels/260947555901374475/518916407577280522]here[/url] 

[h1]Mystic Vale Mondays[/h1]
Don't forget to join us for the first Mystic Vale Monday with Mana Storm next week!
You best get practicing over the weekend! ;)


[b]Happy gaming![/b]
Team Nomad

notes.title: Mystic Vale - OUT NOW
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34002419/e155e3031099feb6b08a6750e9ef155896b49ff7.jpg[/img]

[b]MYSTIC VALE[/b] is a faithful recreation of Alderac Entertainment’s popular CCG where players take on the role of druidic clans trying to cleanse the curse upon the land.

[quote=John Zinser, CEO Alderac Entertainment Group]We asked our partners at Nomad to deliver a game that captures that desire to play again right after you have finished playing.  They succeeded.  All I want to do is play another game of Mystic Vale right now.  We could not be happier.[/quote]

[b]About Mystic Vale[/b]
A curse has been placed on the Valley of Life. Hearing the spirits of nature cry out for aid, clans of druids have arrived, determined to use their blessings to heal the land and rescue the spirits. It will require courage and also caution, as the curse can overwhelm the careless who wield too much power.

The digital edition of MYSTIC VALE allows players to experience its unique Card Crafting System that allows players to actually make the cards they’re fighting with. Unlike other card games, in Mystic Vale, players have total freedom to mix and combine pieces of their cards into something truly unique. This is but one of the fantastic features of MYSTIC VALE:

[list][*]Beautiful artwork and graphics that bring the game to life.
[*]Concise rules offer a deep gaming experience with meaningful decisions.
[*]Tremendous replay value that will increase with future expansions.
[*]Soothing music that transports you to the Vales themselves.[/list]



[h1][b]Changelog[/b][/h1]
[h1] New [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Achievements
[*] Added Leaderboards 
[*] Added some extra info to the Quick Reference guide regarding player deck composition
[*] Online chat added to the results screen
[*] Added end-of-game transition animation
[*] Added keyboard shortcut for opening Online Chat '`' (BackQuote)
[*] Card animations will now play when hovering the mouse over Advancements/Vale Cards
[/list]

[h1] Changes, Improvements and Fixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] TECHNICAL: Game boot loading times greatly improved
[*] ONLINE: Game invites can now be joined from within a game
[*] ONLINE: Added profanity filter to public online games
[*] ONLINE: Added popup for when a player leaves an online game
[*] ONLINE: Added timeout countdown to online games. Players who take too long to make a move will be kicked from the room and replaced with an AI
[*] ONLINE: Accepting an invite to a lobby you are already in, the returning to the title screen, will no longer take you back to the online lobby
[*] GAMEPLAY/UI: Cards will now not be drawn to the field if it is the final round
[*] UI: Fixed an issue where Advancments and Vale cards would briefly glow when ending your turn after Spoiling
[*] UI: Altered how Growth is displayed. Growth counter will now only display unused Growth
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 28/01/19
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34002419/8b3e235b38e0acd1f5485c56e7673b304eff8854.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Changelog[/b][/h1]
[h1] New [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 'Quick Reference' Guide to the title screen and in-game
[*] Added a glow effect to the background in-game
[*] Removed the 'Your Turn' dialog. The current player is now signalled by different coloured particle effects and the background glow colour
[*] Added 'Fast Mode'. Increases the draw speed of the field, as well as transitional animations between turns
[*] Added an optional dialog to inform the player if they have Advancements they can use, if they attempt to end their turn without first using them
[*] Edges of a Player's Field will now glow to indicate if an off-screen Advancement can be used
[*] Added a new dialog to allow the player to select which Spirit token to spend when purchasing a Vale Card which allows any type of Spirit token to be used to purchase it
[*] Added SFX to the particle effects which play when earning resources
[/list]

[h1] Changes, Improvements and Fixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] AI: AI will now treat Ferile Soil as a last resort (cannot buy anything else, and pushing is deemed too much of a risk for the extra Mana)
[*] AI: AI will now push more often on Hard difficulty
 
[*] UI: Pause Dialog will now animate in/out
[*] UI: VP Pool will now glow when the amount of remaining VP tokens is low
[*] UI: Resource counters will now only turn grey when you have 0 of a given token
[*] UI: Player HUD will now automatically switch back to the Player field after purchasing a Vale Card
[*] UI: Fixed an issue where Advancement tooltips were not appearing in the results screen
[*] UI: Fixed an issue where long player names could overflow into other text elements in-game
[*] UI: 'Spoiled' message has been moved to the player action buttons (Push, Pass, End Turn buttons)
[*] UI: Tweaked the glow effect for usable Advancements to help improve visibility
 
[*] Tutorial: Tweaked the wording of a few tutorial steps to improve clarity
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 18/01/19
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34002419/51384ea6120161417538b1c6a40cd418f188ae05.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Changelog[/b][/h1]
[h1] New [/h1]
[list]
[*] In-Game Tutorials have now arrived! The 'How to Play' button has been changed to 'Learn to Play', and will now take you to the list of available tutorials. These tutorials will cover the basics, up to how to win the game.
[*] All Advancements and Vale Cards now feature animations. New SFX has also been added for all Advancements and Vale Cards.
[*] You can now invite your friends to Online games.
[*] In-game chat is now available while playing the game (not just in the pre-game lobby).
[*] Advancements/Vale Cards purchased by other players will now briefly move to the centre of the screen, before moving to their field.
[*] Added a prompt to inform you when it is your turn.
[*] Added particle effects for earning Mana, Victory Points, Decay/Spoiling, Turn changing.
[*] Window resolution can now be selected in-game. Because of this, the initial dialog when booting the game up has been removed.
[*] Added tooltips to 'Field', 'Vale Cards', and 'Discard Pile' buttons in the Player area. These will display the number of cards present in each area.
[/list]

[h1] Changes, Improvements and Fixes [/h1]
[list]
[*] GAMEPLAY: Fixed an issue where opening an Advancement or Vale Card, closing it, then attempting to drag it during Planting or Harvest Phase would cause odd behaviour (and in some cases softlock the game).
[*] GAMEPLAY: Player orders are now randomised at the start of the game (both Online and Offline).
[*] GAMEPLAY: Fixed an issue where placing two Lifebringer Seeds onto a card with 1 Decay would result in an extra Decay being cancelled.
[*] GAMEPLAY/UI: Fixed an issue where switching from viewing another player's field while they purchased an Advancement would cause the game to halt until you switched back to their field.
  
[*] UI: Fixed an issue where the Vale Cards in the Results screen could be dragged around.
[*] UI: All dialogs should now properly display any resource modifications to field cards.
[*] UI: Advancement Resource Tabs slightly reworked. Decay and Growth tokens are now grouped with Spirit Tokens.
[*] UI: Vale Card purchase animations now show the colour of the player who purchased it.
[*] UI: Push, Pass, End Turn, and Options menu button hitboxes tweaked.
[*] UI: Fixed an issue where the Discard Pile was not properly being cleared.
[*] UI: Fixed an issue where using Conclave of Ents to unspoil would not properly update the UI.
[*] UI: Clicking outside of the Pause dialog, and all title screen dialogs, will now dismiss them.
 
[*] AI: AI Players should be less inclined to purchase extensive amounts of Fertile Soil.
[*] AI: Resolved some under-the-hood issues with the AI. Hard AI's should now attempt to synergise certain cards and Advancements a bit better.
[*] AI: Removed various redundant AI difficulty levels. 'Easy', 'Medium', and 'Hard' are now the only difficulties.
[/list]

[b]Important Note: Due to some rather major updates to the game logic, players on this update will not be able to play with other players running previous versions of the game.[/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 17/12/18
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34002419/160346391a97d72addfe409ebd0292d648f0802a.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Changelog[/b][/h1]
[h1] New [/h1]
[list]
[*] Online play is now available! Join existing public games via the room list, or start your own private or public games.
[*] Added a bunch more animations to the Advancements.
[*] Added a 'How to Play' button. This will open a video in your browser which will help teach you how to play. The full tutorial will be coming soon.
[/list]

[h1] Improvements and Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Hard AI should now be a bit harder. It will make smarter decisions when purchasing Advancements, and will make better attempts to synergise.
[*] Fixed an issue with the results screen where the deck view dialog would fail to scroll properly in some cases.
[*] Fixed an issue where player cards could remain highlighted when purchasing Advancements very quickly.
[*] A rule regarding limiting the number of Level 1 Advancements available to purchase is now enforced. 2-Player games will now have 12 Level 1 Advancements, 3-Player games will have 15 Level 1 Advancements, and 4-Player games will now have 18 Level 1 Advancements. Level 2 and Level 3 Advancements are unaffected.
[*] Advancements should now properly order themselves via their Level.
[*] Exodus Road Vale Card price correction (Previous: 1 Animal Spirit and 1 Forest Spirit. Corrected: 1 Animal Spirit and 1 Sky Spirit)
[*] Victory Points are now awarded at the end of your turn, instead of when you enter your harvest phase. This is to allow for certain abilities (such as Conclave of Ents) to be used in the Harvest Phase and still count to your awarded VP.
[*] Advancements and Vale Cards purchased by other players should now properly display that player's colour on the Advancement's glass sleeve/Vale Card's glass border during the purchase animation.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 07/12/18
notes.content:
[h1][b]Update Notes[/b][/h1]
[h1] New [/h1]
[list]
[*] Added new level of AI Difficulty, utilising a newer AI system. To try it out, set an AI's difficulty all the way to very hard.
[*] Added a couple new in-game music tracks.
[*] Added some tooltips to 'Push', 'Go to Harvest Phase', and 'End Turn' buttons (the buttons just below the field).
[*] Added animations to the Earthchant Chorus, Hulking Thornhide, and Mindful Owl Advancements.
[*] Discard Card prompts will now highlight which Advancement or Card Ability invoked the prompt.
[*] Rule regarding viewing other player's discard piles is now enforced. You can no longer view another players discard pile.
[/list]

[h1] Improvements and Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a few minor SFX issues.
[*] Vale Card frames in the player's Vale Card area should now display the correct colour for the player.
[*] Fixed an issue where purchasable Level 2 Vale Cards would incorrectly display as Level 1 Vale Cards when drawn into the Level 1 Card commons.
[*] Fixed an issue where Advancement description tooltips would not properly hide in some cases.
[*] Fixed an issue where Advancements or Vale Cards could, in some cases, render underneath certain elements on the screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where Advancements or Vales Cards could disappear in some cases.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Sunstone Aerie Vale Card would remain highlighted after spending resources on something else.
[*] User selection of Windowed or Fullscreen in the initial configuration dialog (when booting up the game) should now be properly reflected within the in-game settings menus.
[/list]
